title: Pig Launcher

introduction.definition: A pig launcher is the pipeline trap used to insert a pig — a cleaning, batching, gauging or in-line inspection device — into a flowing pipeline. The pig is loaded through a quick-opening closure into an oversize barrel; after the door is closed and the barrel pressurised, valves are lined up so flow through the kicker line enters behind the pig and pushes it through the reducer into the pipeline.
key_points: Never open the door under pressure — interlock
Barrel oversize to load the pig
introduction.summary: A pig launcher is the pipeline trap used to insert a "pig" — a cleaning, gauging or inspection device — into a flowing pipeline. The pig is loaded through the closure door into the oversize barrel; after closing and pressurising, the kicker line and valves are lined up so the flow pushes the pig through the reducer into the pipeline.

foundation: Barrel on saddles/foundations designed for pig impact and thermal movement.
alignment: Align barrel, reducer and pipeline so pigs pass freely.
piping: Trap valve must be full bore; kicker/bypass sized to drive the pig.
Provide vents, drains, pressure gauge and pig signaller.
commissioning: Test door interlock and pressure-warning device.

routine.task: Check door seal and interlock before each use.

overhaul.task: Inspect barrel for corrosion and debris.

lubrication: Closure hinge and locking mechanism per manufacturer.

causes: Insufficient kicker flow, wrong pig size

video_tutorials.title: Pig Launcher — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Pig Launcher.
A pig launcher is the pipeline trap used to insert a pig — a cleaning, batching, gauging or in-line inspection device — into a flowing pipeline.

The pig is loaded through a quick-opening closure into an oversize barrel; after the door is closed and the barrel pressurised, valves are lined up so flow through the kicker line enters behind the pig and pushes it through the reducer into the pipeline.
Typical applications include oil, gas and product pipelines; slurry and water pipelines; pipeline commissioning (dewatering, drying); in-line inspection (intelligent pigs).
The cutaway reveals the internal construction.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Pig Launcher — Operation

script.narration: How the Pig Launcher works.
The pig is loaded through the closure door into the barrel.
The door is closed; the barrel is filled, vented and pressurised.
The trap valve is opened and the kicker valve admits flow behind the pig.
Flow pushes the pig through the reducer into the pipeline.
The signaller confirms the pig has left.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Pig Launcher — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Pig Launcher.
Check door seal and interlock before each use.
Function-test valves and signaller.
Inspect barrel for corrosion and debris.
Watch for pig stuck in reducer/trap: pig not launched, ΔP rises. Common cause: insufficient kicker flow, wrong pig size.
Watch for door seal leak: leak at closure. Common cause: damaged seal.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
